correctness.rationale: PASS: for every m,n>=2 the product of two simplices has rook-graph one-skeleton K_m square K_n. An affine functional takes additive values a_i+b_j; reordering each axis gives exactly Ferrers positive-sign diagrams D with descending row lengths, and every Ferrers diagram can be realized by explicit strict additive values. Generic section vertices are precisely crossed graph edges. For lengths lambda_i and column heights k_j, the count V=Σ lambda_i(n−lambda_i)+Σ k_j(m−k_j) telescopes using square increments to Σ_(i,j) in D(m+n+2−2i−2j). Thus every positive-weight antidiagonal cell is compulsory for equality and every negative-weight cell excluded; zero-weight cells are mutually incomparable, giving 1 generic maximizing Ferrers pattern if m+n odd and 2^min(m,n) if even. Summing positive row weights yields Σ_{i=1}^{min(m,n)}(floor((m+n+1)/2)−i)(ceil((m+n+1)/2)−i). Nongeneric or supporting sections admit generic perturbations with at least as many section vertices; the all-affine maximum follows. For square q, count q(q²−1)/3 vs unrestricted rook cut 2q floor(q²/4), ratio→2/3. Independently enumerated Ferrers lengths and maxima in small m,n and checked combinatorial identities; finite experiments are not used to infer the all-parameter theorem.
